data.situation:
With the repair visit agreed, Lin opened the community calendar on her phone. The planning meeting was marked for Tuesday at ten, just when she needed to let the repair worker in. She called Maya, who was standing beside the paper calendar at the centre. Their names were written in the same square as a painting class. The centre was in a period of transition from paper bookings to an online system, and this entry had not yet been transferred. Maya checked with the class leader: the painters had already confirmed their room. The volunteers would have to defer their meeting. Wednesday at two was free, and Lin could attend then. They were still in the planning phase of the outdoor event, so moving the meeting would not change the event date. The more pressing issue was telling everyone which booking to follow. Maya crossed out the old entry, entered the new one online and sent Lin a draft message before contacting the group. To the volunteers
We have deferred the planning meeting until Wednesday at 2 pm because the room is already booked on Tuesday morning. The outdoor event date has not changed. It is vital that everyone use the new time; please reply so that we know you have seen this message. The corrected booking is now in the online calendar. Lin: Should we say the whole project has been delayed?
Maya: No. Only the meeting. We can still compare locations on Wednesday.
Lin: And the painting class keeps its booking?
Maya: Yes. Both calendars now show that. During the transition, we need to check them together.
Lin: Then the message should explain the change without making the problem sound larger than it is.

readingBlocks.en: With the repair visit agreed, Lin opened the community calendar on her phone. The planning meeting was marked for Tuesday at ten, just when she needed to let the repair worker in. She called Maya, who was standing beside the paper calendar at the centre. Their names were written in the same square as a painting class. The centre was in a period of transition from paper bookings to an online system, and this entry had not yet been transferred. Maya checked with the class leader: the painters had already confirmed their room. The volunteers would have to defer their meeting. Wednesday at two was free, and Lin could attend then. They were still in the planning phase of the outdoor event, so moving the meeting would not change the event date. The more pressing issue was telling everyone which booking to follow. Maya crossed out the old entry, entered the new one online and sent Lin a draft message before contacting the group.
readingBlocks.zh: 约好维修上门后，林打开手机上的社区日历。筹备会议标在星期二十点，恰好是她需要给维修人员开门的时候。她给玛雅打电话；玛雅正站在社区中心的纸质日历旁。她们的名字与绘画课写在同一格里。社区中心正在从纸质预约过渡到线上系统，这条记录还没转过去。玛雅向绘画课负责人确认后得知，对方已经订好了房间。志愿者们只得推迟会议。星期三两点有空档，林那时也能参加。户外活动还在筹备阶段，会议改期不会改变活动日期。更迫切的问题，是告诉所有人应该按哪条预约来。玛雅划去旧记录，在网上填入新时间，并先把消息草稿发给林看，再通知其他组员。

readingBlocks.en:
To the volunteers
We have deferred the planning meeting until Wednesday at 2 pm because the room is already booked on Tuesday morning. The outdoor event date has not changed. It is vital that everyone use the new time; please reply so that we know you have seen this message. The corrected booking is now in the online calendar.
readingBlocks.zh:
致志愿者们
由于星期二上午的房间已被订走，筹备会议推迟到星期三下午两点。户外活动的日期不变。大家都按新时间来很重要；请回复，让我们知道你已经看到消息。更正后的预约已填入线上日历。

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: Should we say the whole project has been delayed?
Maya: No. Only the meeting. We can still compare locations on Wednesday.
Lin: And the painting class keeps its booking?
Maya: Yes. Both calendars now show that. During the transition, we need to check them together.
Lin: Then the message should explain the change without making the problem sound larger than it is.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：要不要说整个项目都延迟了？
玛雅：不用。只是会议改期，我们星期三仍然可以比较活动地点。
林：绘画课保留原来的预约？
玛雅：对。两份日历现在都标清了。过渡期间，得把它们放在一起核对。
林：那消息应该解释清楚变化，也别把问题说得比实际更大。

glossary.note: defer + 名词或 -ing；defer the meeting until Wednesday。
glossary.example: The volunteers would have to defer their meeting.
glossary.exampleZh: 志愿者们只得推迟会议。

externalEvidence.definition: hold back to a later time

glossary.note: 可数名词 a/the phase；in the planning phase。
glossary.example: They were still in the planning phase of the outdoor event.
glossary.exampleZh: 户外活动仍在筹备阶段。

externalEvidence.definition: any distinct time period in a sequence of events

glossary.zh: 过渡；由一种安排转向另一种安排的过程
glossary.note: 本句为名词；a period of transition，transition from A to B。
glossary.example: The centre was in a period of transition from paper bookings to an online system.
glossary.exampleZh: 社区中心正在从纸质预约过渡到线上系统。

externalEvidence.definition: a change from one place or state or subject or stage to another

glossary.zh: 迫切的；需要尽快处理的
glossary.note: 形容词 pressing issue/need；本句不是 press 动词的分词动作，也不表示一般的重要。
glossary.example: The more pressing issue was telling everyone which booking to follow.
glossary.exampleZh: 更迫切的问题，是告诉所有人应该按哪条预约来。

glossary.note: It is vital that ... 表达关键要求；use 可用原形。
glossary.example: It is vital that everyone use the new time.
glossary.exampleZh: 大家都按新时间来很重要。

retrievalPrompts.function: Two meetings on the same square
retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell the volunteers that the meeting is moving to Wednesday at two. Explain why, and make clear that the event date remains the same.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 给志愿者发消息，把会议推迟到星期三下午两点，说明原因，并明确活动日期没改。
acceptableAnswers: We need to defer the meeting until Wednesday at 2 pm because the room is already booked. The outdoor event date has not changed.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: defer the meeting until Wednesday at 2 pm 给出推迟的事项和新时间。只改筹备会议，通知中应把会议与户外活动分别指明，避免让人误以为整场活动延期。
checks: 说明筹备会议推迟到星期三下午两点。
指出星期二的房间已被订走，因此需要改会议时间。
明确户外活动日期保持原定安排。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可用 defer 或推迟、改期的同义说法，时间也可用24小时制；须保留新会议时间、房间预约冲突和活动日期未改，不要求复述绘画课负责人。

retrievalPrompts.function: Two meetings on the same square
retrievalPrompts.cue: A new member finds conflicting paper and online bookings. Explain the transition and the project's current phase.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向新组员解释纸质与线上预约为何冲突，说明项目当前处于什么阶段。
acceptableAnswers: The centre is in a period of transition from paper bookings to an online system. Our event is still in the planning phase.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: transition from A to B 描述系统转换，in the planning phase 描述项目阶段。两者的主语不同：中心在换预约系统，户外活动在筹备。
checks: 说明社区中心正在从纸质预约转向线上系统。
可用尚未转入或两份日历尚未同步解释冲突，不要求逐字补出记录细节。
说明户外活动仍处于筹备阶段。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可把未转入记录说成两份日历尚未同步；须保留转换方向及活动筹备阶段，允许先解释冲突再说明阶段，不必背 a period of transition。

retrievalPrompts.function: Two meetings on the same square
retrievalPrompts.cue: Some members have missed the update. Tell them what needs attention now and which arrangement everyone should follow.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 还有组员没看到消息。说明当前最迫切的问题和所有人应遵循的安排。
acceptableAnswers: The most pressing issue is making sure everyone has seen the change. It is vital that we all use the new meeting time.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: pressing issue 强调现在急需处理的问题；It is vital that… 可接原形 use，也可用 should use。这里的重点是通知到人和统一时间，不是重新讨论活动日期。
checks: 把当前迫切任务指向确保组员看到改期消息。
要求所有人按新的会议时间安排。
pressing 修饰 issue 等问题名词，vital 用于强调这一安排必须被注意。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可用确认已读、逐一联系或要求回复表达通知到位；须保留组员知晓改期及遵循新时间，可用一句或两句组织，也可用 vital to do。

transferPrompt.function: Two meetings on the same square
transferPrompt.cue: A school is moving registration online, but its two lists disagree. Propose checking the lists before postponing a deadline.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 学校由现场报名改为线上报名，两份名单不一致。用一段简报解释过渡期间的问题，提出先核对名单再推迟一个截止日期的方案。
acceptableAnswers: During the transition to online registration, the two lists may not match. The pressing issue is checking who has registered. We could defer the deadline until the lists have been checked; the event itself need not move.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: transition to online registration 适用于系统变更；defer the deadline 的宾语是截止日期。用 could、if 或 until 能让核对与延期的条件关系清楚，简报应说明眼下要核对什么。
checks: 说明学校转向线上报名，两份名单在过渡期间不一致。
提出核对已报名人员及名单，并让延期决定或新期限与核对进度相联系。
把延期写成建议或条件方案，而非已作出的决定。
transferPrompt.answerRangeZh: 可建议核对后再决定延期，也可建议延期至核对完成；须保留线上过渡、名单冲突与核对优先，期限可不指定。活动日期不是本题必填信息，不必复制旧场景结论。
